title: Senl_1904A and Senl_1904B Chimeric Antigen Receptor （CAR） T-Cell in the Treatment of r/ r Acute B Lymphocytic Leukemia
brief_summary: This is an open, two arms, mask phase I clinical study to evaluate efficacy and safety of two different chimeric antigen receptor T cell immunotherapies (Senl\_1904A and Senl\_1904B) targeting cluster of differentiation antigen 19 （CD19） in the treatment of Acute lymphocytic Leukemia. A total of 20 patients are planned to be enrolled following up half a year.
